build_standard_transformer_decoder: build a StandardTransformerDecoder with decoder layers, layer norm, and configurable layer drop probability
create_transformer_decoder_layer_hook: create a TransformerDecoderLayerHook protocol to intercept layer outputs and control early exit from the decoder stack
register_decoder_layer_hook: register a layer hook on a TransformerDecoder to receive callbacks after each layer computes its output
run_decoder_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a StandardTransformerDecoder with sequences, encoder output, and optional incremental state bag
review_layer_drop_iteration: review the StandardTransformerDecoder _drop_iter method that probabilistically skips layers during training using LayerDrop
